summary: Start paused with four simulated nuclear units and a calm orientation guide; inspect live displays and try the Assistant before adding faults yourself.
Norway's largest hydropower station trips on a winter morning; watch inertia and the reserves stop the frequency fall and bring it back to 50 Hz.
Keep kitchens, shelters, a clinic and a pumping station in fictional Halden supplied with trucks of different sizes from two depots.
Establish the PWR’s RHR → CCW → service-water heat path after a primary release, then inspect cooled injection and loss of cooling.
Transfer the PWR’s ECCS source from RWST to the sump through cooled RHR and same-train SI piggyback paths, with actual cold-leg delivery and a continuing-duty handoff.
